329:t_1:86.en:
$$宗介$$
(But at least $$レモン$$ is no enemy. That makes the pressing problem the matter of $$ナムサク$$...)

329:t_1:87.en:
$$宗介$$
(But why is $$レモン$$ trying to save $$ナミ$$...? Goodwill... or something more special...)

329:t_1:90.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ナミ$$ has no engineering knowledge, yet she modified an AS and built the fire control system software all on her own...)

329:t_1:91.en:
$$宗介$$
(Could she be... a 《$$ウィスパード$$》 too...?)

329:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
(No, such a coincidence is impossible. The chance of running into odds of less than one in several million in a place like this...)

329:t_1:96.en:
$$宗介$$
「Gunfire in a place like this!?」

329:t_1:98.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Just kidding! That was only a warning shot, you know!」

329:t_1:99.en:
$$宗介$$
「That voice...! You're with $$アマルガム$$...!」

329:t_1:100.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Too bad! I'm a freelancer now.」

329:t_1:101.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「So, introductions! The century's handsome boy of $$ファイヤバグ$$ - no, the handsome, nice middle-aged gentleman - the great $$ゲイツ$$!」

329:t_1:102.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アマルガム$$ hired you, and you came after me!」

329:t_1:103.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Pretty much. The great $$ゲイツ$$ is super lucky - here in $$ナムサク$$ I can wrap up two jobs at once.」

329:t_1:104.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Wiping out the survivors of $$ミスリル$$, aaand punishing the insolent!」

329:t_1:105.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll cut you down right here!」

329:t_1:106.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Not so fast, as the squid said! $$クラマ$$-chan says he'll be your opponent!」

329:t_1:108.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「By now, sweet little $$ナミ$$-chan is probably in $$クラマ$$-chan's hands.」

329:t_1:110.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hahahaha! That's the face I wanted to see!」

329:t_1:111.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I've got a message from $$クラマ$$-chan. He says he's waiting for you in the arena with $$ナミ$$-chan!」

329:t_1:114.en:
$$宗介$$
(What do I do...? Since $$アマルガム$$ has made a move, if I follow that sideburns guy, I should get some decent intel.)

329:t_2:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(The enemy is $$クラマ$$ and his men... Ten in all...)

329:t_2:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I carelessly step out, I'll be taken down at once. I can't move now...)

329:t_2:7.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Playing hide-and-seek in a place like this won't get us anywhere...」

329:t_2:9.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$相良$$, are you watching!? I know you're there! Come out and throw down your weapons!」

329:t_2:10.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Otherwise, I kill the woman! I'll give you ten seconds!」

329:t_2:13.en:
$$宗介$$
(That man is a pro. He always carries out what he says in negotiations.)

329:t_2:14.en:
$$宗介$$
(And I know from the $$陣代高校$$ incident that he is also a merciless man.)

329:t_2:15.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't take on that many enemies alone. And if I go out and accept $$クラマ$$'s terms, he'll shoot me without a word.)

329:t_2:16.en:
$$宗介$$
(I've survived plenty of hellish battles, and yet to suddenly hit a dead end in a place like this...)

329:t_2:17.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't die in a place like this... Not if I'm going to rescue $$千鳥$$ and make $$レナード$$ and the $$アマルガム$$ lot pay what they owe...)

329:t_2:20.en:
$$宗介$$
(But there's no reason at all for $$ナミ$$ to die. She has nothing to do with $$ミスリル$$ or $$アマルガム$$. I can't let her die here...!)

329:t_2:21.en:
$$宗介$$
(A choice where neither $$ナミ$$ nor I die...)

329:t_2:22.en:
$$宗介$$
(There must be one... There has to be. Think... think...)

329:t_2:24.en:
$$宗介$$
(...There isn't. There's no convenient option like that.)

329:t_2:25.en:
$$宗介$$
(What if $$クラマ$$'s count is a bluff? If I keep holding my breath like this...)

329:t_2:26.en:
$$宗介$$
(No, since he declared he'd shoot $$ナミ$$...)

329:t_2:28.en:
$$宗介$$
(...I have no choice but to go out!)

329:t_2:29.en:
$$宗介$$
(That way I can stretch those two seconds a little. In that time, a chance to turn things around is sure to come...)

329:t_2:30.en:
$$クラマ$$
「...No, I've changed my mind. The countdown ends here.」

329:t_2:32.en:
$$クラマ$$
「If you want to hold a grudge, hold it against $$相良$$.」

329:t_2:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「Run, $$ナミ$$! You can get away now!」

329:t_2:39.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Like hell we'll let you!!」

329:t_2:45.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$クラマ$$! Taking a girl hostage and ignoring your own countdown - that's so like you!」

329:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$クルツ$$! Then that sniping just now was...!」

329:t_2:47.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Me, of course! Who else but the great me could pull off a miracle shot like that!」

329:t_2:48.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Leave the rest to us, $$宗介$$.」

329:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「But why are you all here...」

329:t_2:51.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Information from $$ミシェル・レモン$$.」

uncertain: Gates's ちゃん for Kurama/Nami kept as -chan (mocking nickname, cf. Ranka-chan); ゲイツ様 rendered 'the great Gates'
Heero's 後は任せろ rendered 'Leave the rest to us' (Chirico follows with we); could be 'me'
329:t_2:39 unnamed Amalgam soldier line 'Like hell we'll let you' (plural inferred)
そうはイカの何とか rendered 'Not so fast, as the squid said' (squid pun lost)
329:t_2:44 speaker is Suzaku though pid is Hibiki; followed speaker line
